important_instructions: Attend on the date and session fixed for your subject in the walk-in schedule. The office reserves the right to cancel any or all the applications without assigning any reason. On selection, candidates have to submit an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper in the prescribed proforma as per the NCTE norms. According to the declaration in the application form, if a candidate is found to have concealed or suppressed any material information or given any false details, the engagement shall be liable to be summarily terminated without notice or compensation. For multiple-author publications, the names of the authors must be written in the same order as in the publication; a separate sheet may be attached.

content_sections.heading: About Vikram Dev University
content_sections.text: Vikram Dev University is a university located at Jayapur in Koraput district of Odisha. This recruitment staffs its Four Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (B.A. B.Ed./B.Sc. B.Ed.), run as per the Norms and Standards of NCTE Notification F. No. NCTE. Reg 1011/80/2018-MS (Regulation) HQ dated 22.10.2021, along with its Master of Computer Science and MBA programmes, for the session 2027-28.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All 37 positions are offered on contractual basis with consolidated pay. Candidates must have the specified and desirable qualifications and specialization in the required subjects as per the Norms and Standards of NCTE Guidelines, 2021 and UGC Regulations, 2018. The Integrated Teacher Education Programme accounts for 34 positions (1 Head of the Department, 15 in the Science Unit, 15 in the Humanities Unit and 3 part-time posts), Master of Computer Science for 2 and MBA for 1. Postgraduate degree in Sciences or Mathematics or Social Sciences or Commerce or Languages. M.Ed. Ph.D. in Education. Ten years of teaching experience in a teacher education institution for Professor and eight years for Associate Professor. Any other relevant qualifications prescribed by the University Grants Commission for these categories of posts. Desirable: Diploma/Degree in Educational Administration/Leadership. P.G. in Science (Physics or Chemistry or Botany or Zoology of Life Sciences or Bio Science) or Mathematics or Social Sciences (History or Geography or Political Science or Economics), Language (English or Modern Indian languages or Classical Languages) or Commerce or allied subjects with minimum 55% marks. B.Ed. Degree with minimum 55% marks from a recognized University. National Eligible Test or State Eligible Test or Doctor of Philosophy in Education or in concerned subject as prescribed by the UGC for these categories of posts. Desirable: M.Ed. or M.Ed. with Specialization; Ph.D. Degree in Education. Postgraduate in Education (M.Ed.) with minimum fifty-five marks or equivalent grade. National Eligibility Test or State Eligibility Test or Doctor of Philosophy in Education or in concerned subject as prescribed by the UGC for these categories of posts. Desirable: Master's degree in Psychology or Philosophy or Sociology or their allied subjects. The notice lists under Specialized Courses, for the Physical Education Teacher: Master in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) with minimum fifty-five percent marks or its equivalent grade. The notice lists under Specialized Courses, for Art Education: Post Graduate degree in Fine arts (MFA) with minimum fifty-five percent marks or its equivalent grade. This post is for Career Guidance and Counselling. The notice prints no separate qualification block for it; the designation itself requires Education with Guidance and Counselling as one paper at PG level. First Class in Master in Computer Application/Master in Computer Science/Master of Technology in Computer Science. Desirable: Specialization in AI & ML, Cyber Security and Software Engineering. First Class in Master in Business Administration. Desirable: Specialization in Operation Management and Logistic & Supply Chain Management. The applicant applying for Faculty on contractual basis should be below the age of 65 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Engagement is on contractual basis with consolidated pay for the session 202

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: C.V. All certificates and mark sheets from H.S.C. onwards, duly self-attested. The original copies of the same certificates and mark sheets. An Application Form is printed with the notice (pages 6 and 7). It asks for the post applied for, a passport size photograph, personal and contact details, social category (General/SC/ST/SEBC), academic qualifications from High School/HSC to Ph.D. and NET, thesis titles, area of specialization, teaching experience at universities or colleges, the last institutional affiliation and designation, research publications (books, research papers, other articles, seminar presentations, invited lectures) and a list of the documents enclosed, followed by a signed declaration.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Vikram Dev University walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are held subject-wise on 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14, 15 and 16 December 2026. Each subject has its own date and session in the printed schedule.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Interviews start at 09:00 AM onwards for the morning subject and 02:00 PM onwards for the afternoon subject on each date.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be held in the Conference Hall of Vikram Dev University, Jayapur, Koraput, Odisha.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there in Vikram Dev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 37 positions: 34 for the Integrated Teacher Education Programme, 2 for Master of Computer Science and 1 for MBA.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Assistant Professor in Liberal Discipline and Pedagogy?
faq.answer: A P.G. in the concerned subject with minimum 55% marks, a B.Ed. with minimum 55% marks from a recognized University, and NET or SET or Ph.D. in Education or in the concerned subject as prescribed by the UGC.

faq.question: Q6. What experience is required for the Head of the Department post?
faq.answer: Ten years of teaching experience in a teacher education institution for Professor and eight years for Associate Professor, besides a postgraduate degree, M.Ed. and Ph.D. in Education.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Vikram Dev University faculty posts?
faq.answer: The applicant applying for Faculty on contractual basis should be below the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your C.V with all certificates and mark sheets from H.S.C. onwards, self-attested, along with the original copies of the same.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contractual basis with consolidated pay for the session 2027-28, is purely temporary and can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q10. When will the selected candidates join?
faq.answer: For the Integrated Teacher Education Programme, the engagement takes effect from the commencement of the Academic Session 2027-28, i.e. 17 June 2027.
